# PC Savegames — annotated campaign checkpoint catalogue

- Original source: [Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood](https://www.nicouzouf.com/en/?id=robinhoodthelegendofsherwood)

- Format: header notes, original summary, then the complete listing data

The catalogue lists saves from the Lincoln tutorial through the ending, interleaving principal missions, Sherwood visits, and repeated ambush types. It identifies the package as English, medium difficulty, version 1.1, and gives Profile_001 under DATA/Savegame as the default destination.

Its numbering treats Lincoln as a tutorial and Stuteley’s rescue as mission 1, which explains a numbering difference from guides that count the opening as mission 1. The listing is useful for locating potential comparison checkpoints, but save contents and compatibility remain unverified. Its game-year field says 2003; that metadata is not evidence against the established 2002 release.

Observations from the listing itself: 15 numbered story missions plus a tutorial and an ending save; 19 ambush saves drawn from seven recurring ambush titles (The scouts report a convoy, A poorly escorted carriage, A wealthy tradesman, The apprentice, Rookies, A convoy / A Convoy!, The Tax Collector, The Treasure); 33 Sherwood Forest intermissions. The largest saves are the castle missions (The Black Castle, The Silver Arrow, The March on York, Last Challenge) and The End.
